thread:
elaine: Quick proposal 1 create a 'DP lifecycle handbook' for incoming design partners. Default engagement = 6 weeks, optional 4-week extension. Purpose: standardize recruiting, onboarding, feedback cadence, and go/no-go gates.

raj: +1. Suggested KPIs: partner NPS (post-pilot) >= 7/10, feature retention (feature routed to partner prod and kept >= 8w), measurable perf or cost delta (e.g., p99 down >15% OR token cost down >10%). Also track feedback velocity (# actionable items/week).

marta: Recruiting checklist: production traffic (min 20 rps), engineering sponsor, compliance ok with 30-day anonymized traces, timezone overlap (PST or CET overlap preferred). Must commit to 3 scheduled feedback sessions.

ben: Scoring rubric proposal: signal (0-4), traffic (0-4), security posture (0-3), timeline fit (0-2). Pass threshold = 10. Flag as priority if partner pays for dedicated support or is strategic for sales.

rebecca: Engagement playbook (high level): Week0 = onboarding + baseline collection + shared runbook; Weeks1-3 = iterative tuning and daily quick syncs as needed; Week4 = stabilization + adoption workshop; Weeks5-6 = wrap, final report, handoff. Deliverables: partner dashboard, weekly 1-pagers, ops runbook + roll-back instructions.

ops-bot: capacity-check: free_reserved_slots=2, est_cost=$4500/slot/mo. To allocate: `/reserve pilot slots=1 tag=lifecycle`. Reserving gives isolation but reduces pool for ad-hoc tests.

elaine: Feedback capture = two channels: (1) structured form (prompt_id, rating 1-5, short note, real vs synthetic) and (2) short async session notes after each feedback meeting. Incentives: $5k platform credit or co-marketing callout.

raj: Go/no-go rules (explicit): must satisfy at least one of: (A) technical improvement >15% on primary SLO OR (B) adoption: partner keeps feature live AND shows business signal (e.g., conversion metric improves). Also require no outstanding critical security issues.

marta: Legal ops ask: DP addendum (telemetry opt-in, 30-day retention max, partner right to pause synthetic runs, rollback clause, explicit fallback behavior and expected quality delta). I'll draft and share.

ben: Outreach DM (short): "Hi <name> 0 interested in a short collaborative pilot to reduce latency and cost? 6 weeks, we provide tooling + a shared dashboard. Reply with avg req/s and a dev contact." Use this on existing ticket owners first.

rebecca: UX note: dashboard must be editable by partner and show: prompt set, p50/p95/p99 sparkline, weekly deltas, recent action items with owners, and a one-click "pause synthetic tests" toggle.

elaine: Next steps: Marta -> DP addendum draft by Wed EOD; Ops -> confirm slot reservation by Thu; Rebecca -> dashboard prototype by next Tue; Jen -> compile outreach candidate list from last 90d tickets. Any blockers?

jen: I'll pull the list today.

raj: No blockers from my side. :rocket:
